entities.title: The name rules
entities.summary: cleanName: what a name on the table may be. Samosa's src/name.ts is the source; the Worker imports it and Rally copies it.
consumers: worker/scores.ts, which cleans every submitted name with it
games/rally/src/name.ts, which copies the same rules, so a name typed in one game is valid in the other
guarantees: Accents dropped and þ, ð, æ, ø, ß, œ and ł spelled out; only letters, digits, spaces and . ' _ - kept; spaces collapsed
A name with no letter or digit cleans to "", which the table refuses
nameFromEmail gives the part of an address before the @ and any +tag, in capitals, with underscores as hyphens, typeable on the name entry's keys
entities.compatibility: A change here changes what the Worker accepts and must be made in Rally's copy too; nothing checks the two agree (Rally's backlog item name-copies).

entities.title: The session name
entities.summary: sessionStorage games.name: the table name, shared by every game on icelander.net for the browser session.
consumers: Rally (games/rally), which reads and writes the same key
guarantees: Holds a name already cleaned by cleanName, saved only once the server has accepted a reign under it
